'''Gorothite''' was the native language of the [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothites]] of [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]].

==Words and phrases==
*'''b'len jor''' &mdash; "deathlight"
*'''B'Pen''' &mdash; "Majority"
*'''[[K'Ji'Kur]]''' &mdash; "beholding"
*'''[[M'Nes]]''' &mdash; "True Faith"
*'''[[J'ber V'Sook|M'Nes Brin''']]''' &mdash; "Receptacle of the True Faith"
*'''[[M'Nes K'Lar]]''' &mdash; "Sanctuary of the True Faith"
